# Mistral Boréal
Independent, free, fully bilingual (fr-CA and en-CA) Canadian Mistral AI user community; not an official Mistral AI website.

FR: https://mistralboreal.github.io/
EN: https://mistralboreal.github.io/en-ca/
Meetups: https://mistralboreal.github.io/rencontres/
Articles: https://mistralboreal.github.io/articles/
Learning: https://mistralboreal.github.io/formation/
Source and contributions: https://github.com/mistralboreal/mistralboreal.github.io

Editorial source: knowledge/okf, paired by translation_key. Meetups without confirmed dates must not be described as booked or open for registration. Training links lead to Mistral AI's own documentation.
